english:
Primary Ammo weapon kills against Combatants grant 3% additional Special Ammo Progress while your Special Ammo reserves are below 20%.

Special Ammo weapon kills against Combatants grant 2% additional Heavy Ammo Progress while your Heavy Ammo reserves are below 20%.

source.text:
4 Piece | Built from Scratch

Combatant Kills grant additional Ammo Progress based on their Ammo Type if Ammo Reserves are low.

Primary Ammo Weapons grant +3% Special Ammo Progress while Special Ammo Reserves <20%.
Special Ammo Weapons receive +2% Heavy Ammo Progress while Heavy Ammo Reserves <20%.
